rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] handed the watch at the stall over to [RECIPIENT_nameDef].
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] that nothing happened, then described it at length.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] passed the watch to [RECIPIENT_nameDef], along with a list of colonists not to trust.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] warned [RECIPIENT_nameDef] about the colonist who keeps touching the wares.
r_logentry->[RECIPIENT_nameDef] took over the watch from [INITIATOR_nameDef], who was already yawning.
